column17: Whether the parameter should have a higher value or a lower value for a positive outcome
Weightages given to the parameters adding up to 100
(The weightage * corresponding value for all column values under 'higher') - (The weightage * corresponding values for all column values under 'lower')  = score
The final score column is then sorted from highest to lowest to get the final ranking.
